title: 云服务开始提价：外卖价格战缓和，科技盈利要翻身？
speaker: Alicia Yap

segments.en: Okay. Any indication that those price wars are something of a passive? Yeah. Are you starting to see more signs of that? You mean the more advertising wall?
segments.zh: 有迹象表明价格战正在缓和吗？您是否看到更多信号？您是指广告方面？

segments.en: Yeah. E-commerce space. How do these businesses actually look? Advertising and all these things.
segments.zh: 电商领域，这些业务实际表现如何？广告等。

segments.en: Yeah. So the food delivery pricing more is behind us. Okay. That's why you see the earnings recovery for Baba on the commerce side, for Maituan and even for JD, which is tonight.
segments.zh: 外卖定价压力已过，因此阿里电商、美团甚至今晚的京东盈利都在修复。

segments.en: And then on the commerce, unfortunately, the big pictures, the macros remain quite weak.
segments.zh: 但电商方面，宏观环境仍偏弱。

segments.en: So that will still wait on, you know, the GMV and the CMR growth for Baba, for example.
segments.zh: 因此阿里等平台的GMV和CMR增长仍承压。

segments.en: Yeah. And then the cloud pricing war, I think Tencent talked about yesterday. It seems like they are also able to raise prices.
segments.zh: 云服务价格战方面，腾讯昨日提到，他们似乎也能提价。

segments.en: So it's not like, you know, really that everyone is driving down the prices. Indeed, you know, they can use the higher input cost to actually raise their cloud product costs.
segments.zh: 并非所有厂商都在压价，他们可以利用更高投入成本来提高云产品价格。

segments.en: We've been talking to our guests this week about, this seems to be a sea change of how people are looking at trying a big tech now.
segments.zh: 本周我们与嘉宾讨论，市场看待中国大型科技股的方式似乎正在转变。
